leaves.definition: Substantive evidence whose precise canonical concept still requires review.
An already observed security price move.
An already observed trading-volume or attention move.
An analyst initiates, maintains, upgrades or downgrades a rating.
An analyst establishes or changes a price target.
Reported earnings or operating performance.
An issuer schedules or announces the timing of an earnings or financial-results release.
An issuer announces, files or completes a correction or restatement of previously reported financial results.
The issuer issues, raises, lowers, reaffirms or withdraws guidance.
An acquisition, merger or takeover event.
Debt, equity or other financing activity.
Dividend, repurchase or other return of capital.
A regulator or exchange takes or announces an official action.
A lawsuit, investigation, settlement or other legal proceeding.
A clinical or medical regulatory milestone or decision.
A material customer contract, order, award or cancellation.
A product launch, delay, recall or discontinuation.
A material executive, director or governance change.
A shareholder meeting, election, proposal or ratification vote and its reported outcome.
A material operating expansion, disruption, restructuring or business update.
Market, sector or macro context that is not an issuer event.
A confirmed, planned or historical trading halt, suspension, resumption or comparable security trading-status condition.
Observed options activity or flow.
An assessment of valuation or strategic attractiveness.
Listing, compliance, split, IPO or other market-structure event.
A change or assessment concerning competitive position or market share.
A reported, expected or assessed change or condition in customer demand for an issuer's products, services or brands.
A partnership, collaboration, licensing, supply or distribution agreement.
A reported or expected margin change or condition.
A reported operating-income, sales, EBITDA or comparable operating metric.
A reported or expected cash-flow condition.
A cash, liquidity or proceeds condition.
A confirmed, estimated or potential financial loss, charge, impairment or comparable adverse exposure.
A reported or expected change or condition in delinquencies, charge-offs, defaults or comparable issuer credit-performance measures.
A change in an estimate that is distinct from formal issuer guidance.
An insider, institutional or other ownership-position change.
A reported current or historical ownership stake without an asserted change.
A non-financing capital-structure change.
A material credit, default, bankruptcy or solvency condition.
Addition to or removal from an index.
A cost-saving, expense or efficiency change.
A material capacity expansion or contraction.
A reported current, historical or expected workforce size or employment footprint.
A review or pursuit of strategic alternatives, investments or asset sales.
A published short thesis or adverse research assessment.
An analyst's issuer-specific assessment or defense that is not itself a rating or price-target action.
An issuer-specific assessment or forecast attributed to an external investor, executive, specialist or other non-analyst source.
An observed move for which no new catalyst was identified.
An already observed buying, selling or allocation flow in a security or asset.
An already observed bond price, yield, spread or fixed-income market condition.
An already observed exchange-rate or currency-price move.
An already observed commodity spot, futures or benchmark price condition.
A reported, expected or assessed consumer- or producer-price inflation condition.
A household debt, credit, loan or consumer-balance condition.
An assessment or forecast of broad economic growth, recession or economic conditions.
A reported or expected import, export or cross-border trade condition.
A reported, expected or assessed cross-border direct-investment inflow or outflow condition.
A reported or expected fiscal, monetary or government-policy action or condition.
A reported, expected or historical consumer-confidence or consumer-sentiment reading.
A reported, expected or assessed consumer-spending or retail-demand condition.
A reported, expected or assessed household personal-income or disposable-income condition.
A reported, expected or assessed employment, payroll, unemployment or workforce condition.
A reported, expected or assessed GDP or broad economic-output condition.
A regulator schedules, proposes, adopts or changes a rule or formal policy proceeding.
A government or supranational body imposes, extends, lifts or considers sanctions.
A reported or expected development in negotiations, disputes or policy governing international trade.
A reported public-health emergency, outbreak, death toll or comparable health-system event.
A reported, proposed or assessed labor-union organization or collective-bargaining condition.
A reported evacuation, suspicious package, security threat or comparable public-safety incident.
A scheduled, ongoing or completed interview, broadcast appearance or comparable media event.
A reported or expected diplomatic, governmental or strategic cooperation agreement or implementation.
A reported, considered or expected military action, escalation or armed-conflict risk.
An assessment of a digital asset's monetary, regulatory, financial-system or policy role.
A reported, expected or historical wholesale, retail or other business-inventory condition.
A reported, expected or assessed housing-sales, construction or related housing-market condition.
A reported, expected or historical current-account, trade-balance or external-financing condition.
A reported or expected hurricane, earthquake, flood, wildfire or comparable natural-hazard event.
A reported or expected coalition, cabinet, leadership or government-formation development.
A reported cyberattack, ransomware event, data breach or material information-system disruption.
A reported, expected or historical commodity, livestock or agricultural production and processing condition.
A reported or expected commodity inventory build or draw.
A reported or assessed banking-system, deposit-system or financial-stability condition.
A reported or assessed state action concerning protests, civil liberties or human rights.
A confirmed or planned troop deployment, defense commitment or other non-combat military posture action.
A reported or assessed nuclear-facility accident, reactor failure or radiological release.
An assessment of media coverage, disclosure, suppression or reporting conduct.
An editorial or professional assessment about portfolio allocation, hedging or risk positioning.
An issuer states a material operating, financial or execution priority or objective that is not quantified formal guidance.
The founding, incorporation or formal establishment of an organization or institution.
A legislature enacts, amends or repeals a law or statutory governance requirement.
A confirmed historical or current battle, military defeat or comparable armed-force event.
A reported, expected or historical interest-rate level or change.
A historical or current monetary-system, note-issuance, gold-standard or central-bank institutional condition.
A political candidate announces, launches, ends or materially updates an election campaign.
A political figure, party or external source assesses a proposed or enacted public policy.
